vatBadDebtRelief.title: Bad-debt relief
vatBadDebtRelief.description: Claim back output VAT on written-off invoices (UAE VAT law, Federal Decree-Law 8 of 2017, Article 64).
vatBadDebtRelief.emptyBody: When an overdue invoice has been written off and the customer notified, claim the VAT back here.
vatBadDebtRelief.waitingBody: Your claims will load when you are back online.
vatBadDebtRelief.refreshFailed: We couldn't refresh your claims. Showing the last loaded list.
vatBadDebtRelief.reverseBody: Reversing the claim for invoice {invoice} adds back the relief not yet recovered through customer payments: {amount}. A ledger entry is posted on the date below, and output VAT payable goes up by that amount in the VAT return for the period containing {date}.
vatBadDebtRelief.reverseFailed: The claim could not be reversed
vatBadDebtRelief.createIntro: The invoice must be written off in the accounts first, more than six months must have passed since the date of supply, and the customer must have been notified. The server checks each rule.
vatBadDebtRelief.createWrittenOff: The debt has been written off in the accounts
vatBadDebtRelief.createNotified: The customer has been notified of the write-off
vatBadDebtRelief.createFailed: The claim could not be recorded
vatBadDebtRelief.reverseBodyNothing: Customer payments have already recovered all of the relief on invoice {invoice}. Reversing the claim closes it; no further VAT is added back and no ledger entry is posted.
vatBadDebtRelief.reasonPayment: Payment received after bad-debt relief was claimed
vatBadDebtRelief.periodNeutral: Reported in the VAT return for the period containing {date}
vatBadDebtRelief.reversalPeriodRecovered: Recovered over customer payments, in the VAT return for the period containing each payment date, or the next open period if that return is already filed
vatBadDebtRelief.createCapNote: Showing the 500 most recent eligible invoices. Older ones are not listed here.
vatBadDebtRelief.periodStatus.submitted: finalised in the app, not yet filed in EmaraTax
vatBadDebtRelief.periodStatus.unverified: locked, VAT group membership still to be verified
vatBadDebtRelief.partialRecoveredLead: Partly recovered over customer payments, in:
vatBadDebtRelief.claimedAgainAmount: relief claimed again: {amount} (a reversed recovery reduces the add-back)
